message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Build the dashboard

on: 
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:

jobs:
  build:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Use Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '20.x'
      - name: Cache npm dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.npm
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-node-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-node-
      - run: npm ci
      - run: cp env.template .env
      - run: make build
      - run: make test
      - run: make lint

  e2e:
    name: Browser tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Use Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '20.x'
      - name: Cache npm dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.npm
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-node-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-node-
      - run: npm ci
      - run: cp env.template .env
      - run: make e2e-install
      - run: make e2e
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: failure()
        with:
          name: playwright-report
          path: playwright-report/
          retention-days: 7",
  "rationale": "Both jobs run `npm ci` on every run and the repository pins dependencies in package-lock.json, so repeated dependency fetching is measurable and cache inputs include the lockfile plus a fixed Node 20.x environment. This matches pattern P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (cache dependency downloads): keep `npm ci` and all required tests (build, test, lint, e2e) intact, and only add a restoreable cache of the npm dependency state keyed on the lockfile hash. No required checks are removed, no permissions are weakened, and no new secrets, publishing, deployment, or network targets are introduced.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
